blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Six areas reached danger-level heat indices on Tuesday amid the effects of El Niño, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) categorizes indices ranging between 42°C and 51°C as “danger” level due to increased risks of heat cramps and heat exhaustion, which could then lead to heat stroke.
